description: The appointment or cessation of a director, CEO, secretary or auditor, lodged with ACRA within 14 days
A change in a position holder's particulars, lodged within 14 days (a Singapore citizen or permanent resident reports their own name, address or ID to ICA instead)
A change of the registered office, lodged within 14 days
Newly issued shares and share transfers, reported within 14 days: ACRA's guidance; the Act sets no period for a private company's return
A secretary appointed within six months of registration: ACRA's guidance, from s171(4A)
The secretary's office not vacant for more than six months
An auditor appointed within three months of incorporation, unless the company is exempt from audit
A change of a registrable controller entered in the company's register within seven days
The change filed with ACRA's central register within two business days after the company's register
A notice to each registrable controller at least once a year
A director or shareholder who becomes a nominee after incorporation informs the company within 30 days
A change of a nominee director or nominee shareholder entered in the company's register within seven days
The change filed with ACRA's central ROND and RONS within two business days after the company's register
